Subject: Follow-up: monthly spend band + procurement lanes (post-demo)

Maria / procurement team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we can lock the budget band and procurement lane: 

Recap (from call)
- Expected initial usage profile: roughly 75M–300M tokens/month (demo workload + burst).
- Target pricing we discussed: Redwood target $12.50 per 1M tokens (volume tiers to follow in the estimate).
- Implied monthly spend band at $12.50/1M: roughly $1k – $3.8k. This is a starting corridor we used for sizing the demo and pilot.
- Procurement threshold note: you mentioned vendor approval gates matter — we should surface any PO thresholds that trigger additional legal review.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the monthly band above (75M–300M) is the right corridor for procurement sizing? If not, send approximate low/high token numbers.
2) Confirm your PO threshold that would trigger legal/contract reviews (we heard ~>$75k on the call but want it explicit).
3) I’ll attach the demo deck and a preliminary pricing estimate; Priyom will prepare a short one-pager for procurement that calls out token breakout and unit economics.
4) Proposed short timeline: we’ll send the questionnaire and estimate today; if procurement needs a one-pager, we can get that to you within 48 business hours.

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Deck.pdf (deck, slides 1–12)

If you’re good with that, I’ll also loop in Laura from Legal (internal) to start a light touch review once procurement confirms the PO threshold.

Thanks — Soojin

Thanks, Soojin — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Usage profile: we expect to start around 150M tokens/month (pilot), ramping toward ~350M tokens/month by Q3 if initial quality and latency look good.
- Procurement thresholds: our internal procurement policy flags any vendor PO > $75,000 for additional legal and InfoSec review. Anything below that is usual PO route (~2–4 week turnaround).
- Timeline: procurement estimate for a standard vendor questionnaire and PO (if below the legal threshold) is ~3 weeks; if the PO will exceed $75k, plan on 5–7 weeks while we loop Legal.

On the pricing: the $12.50/1M target looks reasonable for conversation, but procurement will want a clear tiered rate in the estimate and a 3–6 month pilot pricing line item for budgeting.
